summary.title: PBM Claims Processing Platform
summary.description: Threat model for the pharmacy benefit management claims processing pipeline covering web client, API gateway, and member database tiers.

data.name: Web Client
data.description: Pharmacy operator browser accessing the PBM claims portal.

threats.title: Pharmacy credential theft via phishing
threats.description: An attacker may obtain pharmacy operator credentials through targeted phishing campaigns, enabling unauthorized claims submission under a legitimate pharmacy identity.
threats.mitigation: Enforce MFA for all pharmacy operator logins; implement FIDO2 hardware tokens for high-privilege accounts; rotate credentials quarterly and alert on anomalous login geography.

threats.title: Session token replay from XSS
threats.description: Reflected or stored XSS in the claims portal could allow an attacker to steal session tokens and replay them to submit fraudulent claims or alter in-flight claim data.
threats.mitigation: Apply Content-Security-Policy headers; sanitize all user-supplied HTML; bind session tokens to client TLS fingerprint.

data.name: API Gateway
data.description: REST API gateway that validates, routes, and authorizes claims from pharmacy operators.

threats.title: Adjudication result tampering via unsecured admin endpoint
threats.description: An insider or compromised service account could modify adjudication outcomes via an unauthenticated internal admin API, altering approved/denied status and payout amounts.

threats.title: PHI leakage through verbose error responses
threats.description: Unhandled exceptions in the claims API may expose member PHI (name, date of birth, diagnosis codes) in HTTP 500 response bodies, violating HIPAA Minimum Necessary and enabling targeted fraud.
threats.mitigation: Strip PHI from all error responses; return opaque error codes only; ship structured logs containing PHI exclusively to the internal SIEM.

data.name: Member Database
data.description: PostgreSQL database storing member eligibility, claim history, and PHI for the PBM platform.

threats.title: Mass PHI exfiltration via SQL injection in eligibility lookup
threats.description: Unsanitized member ID parameters in the eligibility query path could allow an attacker to perform UNION-based SQL injection, exfiltrating the entire member table including SSN, DOB, and prescription history.
threats.mitigation: Parameterize all database queries; apply principle of least privilege to the claims_api role; enable pg_audit logging for SELECT on member tables.

threats.title: Claims database unavailability via unthrottled bulk reprocessing
threats.description: Pharmacy operators or an automated attacker submitting bulk claim reprocessing requests can saturate the member database connection pool, causing claims processing downtime that delays patient medication access.
threats.mitigation: Apply per-pharmacy rate limits at the API gateway; implement connection pool sizing and queue-based backpressure for bulk reprocessing jobs.
